# #4120: Patch: follow-up to #4098 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4098 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4098 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44056054410)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`a5d9d4864f12`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4098 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs:5677`: `a_corpus_record_uses_its_pinned_endings_channel_flag` requires seed 3760's channel game to end by concede, accepted draw, disconnect or match ceiling. That is a chance outcome of one drifting game, not a property of the change, so unrelated card, engine or AI changes will turn this per-PR test red.
  Evidence: The test is not `#[ignore]`d, so it runs in the per-PR `tools fuzz` group (`.github/ci/rust-test.toml`: `-p jackioh-tools --bin jackioh -- fuzz:: ...`). `scripts/ci-scope.sh` turns that group on for card and engine changes. A channel game ends early only with `ENDINGS_END_CHANCE` = 0.004 per step. Over the ~100–130 actions of seed 3760's game that is roughly a 35–40% chance, so whenever a change to any of its 50 pinned cards, the engine or the policy alters the game, `assert!(ENDINGS_TERMINAL_REASONS.contains(&with.reason...))` most likely fails. The `assert_ne!(with.hash, without.hash)` that follows already proves `replay_record` uses `record.endings`. The plan asked for something sturdier: check that the log holds an action the policy never sends (via `play_game_with_options`). Fix: drop the terminal-reason assertion, or replace it with that log check. The `!ENDINGS_TERMINAL_REASONS.contains(&without.reason)` half is also always true: `check_termination` already refuses those reasons when there is no channel.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
